tools.name: mattermost_save_draft
tools.description: Write one message into the owner's own Mattermost drafts or reply box. The child never posts: sending is the web client's own click.

tools.name: mattermost_list_drafts
tools.description: List the drafts the owner already has, so a draft can be confirmed without sending anything.
